verdict.rationale: x402 is API-native, so its whole documented surface is programmatic. Payment, verification and settlement run over HTTP 402 and the hosted Facilitator API. Bazaar listing happens automatically through the SDK with "no registration form," and discovery is available through public APIs, a generated OpenAPI client and an MCP server; a runtime probe confirmed the keyless discovery endpoint returns live listings and that the SDK is published on npm. Missing for 10: no explicit statement of API/UI parity; no evidence that CDP account setup and API-key provisioning (needed for the 401-gated facilitator) can be done without a dashboard; no published OpenAPI spec at the probed doc paths.
